scenes.title: Ring doorbell missing people?
scenes.body: No alert until they're already at the door, or no alert at all. Here's what we check on every install.

scenes.title: Open Motion Settings
scenes.body: Ring app → Devices → your doorbell → Motion Settings. Names vary a little by model.

scenes.title: Raise Motion Sensitivity
scenes.body: Move the slider up one or two notches. Higher = longer detection range.

scenes.title: Fix your Motion Zones
scenes.body: Make sure the zones cover your walkway and porch, not just the doorstep. Up to 3 zones per device.

scenes.title: Set Motion Frequency to Frequently
scenes.body: Advanced Settings → Motion Frequency. Uses more battery, catches more events.

scenes.title: Check height and angle
scenes.body: About 4 ft high works best. A wedge or corner kit points it at the path people actually walk.

scenes.title: Check Wi-Fi and power
scenes.body: Device Health: a weak signal or low battery means late or missed alerts. Fix those first.

scenes.title: Go back one notch
scenes.body: Lower sensitivity or trim the zone to drop street traffic. Change one setting at a time and test.
